rationale: Maintains a full monster-rally register throughout with ALL-CAPS cadence, escalating stakes (THUNDERDOME, FIRE-BREATHIN’, TURBO-CHARGED) and spectacle applied to mundane potluck specifics (aunt’s seven-layer salad, dessert table). Voice never slips into normal announcement tone.
quote: It’s the ANNUAL POTLUCK SMACKDOWN — where casseroles collide, crockpots roar, and desserts enter the arena with NO MERCY!
